title: Unfiltered
description: Minecraft, Unfiltered, pure realism and performances
body:
Unfiltered's main objective is realism, and beauty, but sadly peoples that dont have the hardware normally can't, but now they can! Even with a potato pc you can run **_shaders_** with incredible render distances, like **200 chuncks**!

Note that it **isn't only made for peoples with bad harware** using it over other mods is way better, **optimization is key** if you want to push your Minecraft even more while staying at **high FPS count** its perfect!

If you liked this modpack check out my other ones!
